The nursing campus

The nursing college and hospital are located opposite the medical compound.

Classes, clinical practice and hostel life

Students learn in dedicated clinical labs and wards, and the campus has its own dining hall and hostels.

Courses and admissions

For the current courses, eligibility, intake and affiliation details, please contact the college office.

B.Sc. Nursing · Undergraduate

SVS offers B.Sc. Nursing and Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing. Post Basic B.Sc. is an undergraduate degree route for eligible nursing diploma holders; it is not a postgraduate programme. Ask the college about eligibility and current admission requirements for each route.

M.Sc. Nursing · Postgraduate

M.Sc. Nursing is the postgraduate route at SVS College of Nursing. Contact the nursing college for current specialties, eligibility, clinical requirements and counselling information.

Contact the college office

For nursing course details and admission enquiries, call 08542-227902 or email svsmc_mbnr@yahoo.co.in.
